steps.title: Фильтрация и проекция
steps.content:
## SELECT

- **`WHERE`**: `AND` / `OR`, не забывайте **`IS NULL`**.
- **`DISTINCT`**, **`ORDER BY`**, **`LIMIT`**.
- SQLite: `LENGTH(text)` вместо `CHAR_LENGTH`.

content.caption: SELECT возвращает подмножество строк/столбцов
content.description: Условие в WHERE отсеивает строки до проекции.

content.description:
Выведите `product_id` товаров, которые **одновременно** low fat (`low_fats = 1`) и recyclable (`recyclable = 1`).

[LeetCode 1757](https://leetcode.com/problems/recyclable-and-low-fat-products/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Products(product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, low_fats INTEGER NOT NULL, recyclable INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT product_id FROM Products WHERE low_fats = 1 OR recyclable = 1;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT product_id FROM Products WHERE low_fats = 1 AND recyclable = 1;

content.description:
Выведите `name` клиентов, которые **не** были приглашены referee с `id = 2`. Если `referee_id` NULL — клиент тоже подходит.

[LeetCode 584](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-customer-referee/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Customer(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, referee_id INTEGER);
content.starterCode: SELECT name FROM Customer WHERE referee_id <> 2;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT name FROM Customer WHERE referee_id != 2 OR referee_id IS NULL;

content.setup: CREATE TABLE World(name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, continent TEXT NOT NULL, area INTEGER NOT NULL, population INTEGER NOT NULL, gdp INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT name, population, area FROM World WHERE area > 3000000 AND population > 25000000;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT name, population, area FROM World WHERE area >= 3000000 OR population >= 25000000;

content.description:
Авторы, которые просматривали **свои** статьи. Верните `id` (author_id) **без дубликатов**, по возрастанию.

[LeetCode 1148](https://leetcode.com/problems/article-views-i/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Views(article_id INTEGER NOT NULL, author_id INTEGER NOT NULL, viewer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, view_date TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT author_id AS id FROM Views WHERE author_id = viewer_id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT DISTINCT author_id AS id FROM Views WHERE author_id = viewer_id ORDER BY id;

content.description:
Невалидный твит: длина `content` **строго больше** 15 символов. Верните `tweet_id`.

[LeetCode 1683](https://leetcode.com/problems/invalid-tweets/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Tweets(tweet_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, content TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT tweet_id FROM Tweets WHERE LENGTH(content) >= 15;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT tweet_id FROM Tweets WHERE LENGTH(content) > 15;

tests.seed: INSERT INTO Tweets VALUES (1,'Vote for Biden'),(2,'Let us make America great again!');
